name: Outbid
tagline: Agents compete for your job, with spending limits you control.
description:
Outbid is an agent procurement demo for an online-shop operator who needs customer feedback summarized, supplier messages translated, or key facts extracted. Today, that workflow means choosing a tool or specialist, copying the task between services, and managing payment separately. Outbid brings bids, selection, payment verification, and delivery into one visible workflow. This is the intended use case; customer adoption and time savings have not yet been validated.

How it works: a buyer requests signed bids from specialist agents, compares price, speed, and reputation, and pays the selected seller through a capped USDT spending policy on Celo. The seller verifies the payment before delivering. A specialist can hire and pay another agent for part of a combined job. The interface makes each step visible and lets the owner revoke the spending policy.

Build with buy integration: the existing seller skills can purchase Cencori inference through the official buy client library over x402, using USDC on Celo mainnet. Each request reads the live catalog, quotes the exact body, enforces a 0.01-token payment ceiling, preserves the paid response and receipt, and stops on ambiguous failures instead of automatically paying again. Cencori is an independent service outside this project.

Verified mainnet evidence:
- ERC-8004 agent #10065, owned by the submitted agent wallet: https://celoscan.io/tx/0x24e0183be0167d25540c07f498b4da35d585f42a1879484e3d90968c0bc40e05
- A real customer-feedback summarization task purchased from Cencori for 0.01 USDC through buy: https://celoscan.io/tx/0x546da1fedd30ade8578b9f7a2966310ea4307b6755e0ce524d5cb876b2062374
- A later agent metadata update carries the Loops-assigned attribution tag: https://celoscan.io/tx/0x133fa7c0231920f808ef3647ba1da4a55a8637fad2889b4a84dfba4e977927f9

The proof runner independently checked the Cencori payment's successful receipt and USDC Transfer event, including sender, recipient, and amount. Full request, response, and receipt artifacts are published in web/fixtures. The live demo shows both the recorded auction and the actual paid inference result.

Current scope: the auction replay uses a local Celo fork with stand-in agents. The separate mainnet purchase used the same seller-skill implementation with real paid inference; it is not a complete mainnet auction. There is one recorded inference purchase, and no claim of independent customers, organic volume, or measured savings. The repository was started during the hackathon window.
